# GET /api/v1/signing-key.gpg

Returns the GPG public key of the default signing key

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** none · **ID:** `ep-004`

## Response

**200** — text/plain

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `body` | string | GPG armored public key |

- **404** — No signing key configured or format is not openpgp
- **500** — Error running gpg --export or reading key

## Workflow

| Step | Module | Component | Type | Details |
|------|--------|-----------|------|---------|
| 1 | [routers](../modules/routers.md) | misc.SigningKeyGPG | controller | Call getSigningKey with format=openpgp |
| 2 | [services](../modules/services.md) | asymkey_service.PublicSigningKey | service ⚡ | Call git.GetSigningKey to get key info; If SSH format: read file from disk; If GPG format: exec gpg --export -a <keyID> |
| 3 | [modules](../modules/modules.md) | git.GetSigningKey | utility ⚡ | Check setting.Repository.Signing.SigningKey; If 'none': return nil; If 'default': read git global config; Otherwise: use configured key |

## Business Rules

| Rule | Category | Condition |
|------|----------|-----------|
| Signing key format must match expected format (openpgp or ssh), otherwise 404 | business_logic | format != expectedFormat |
| If signing key is 'none', no key is returned | business_logic | setting.Repository.Signing.SigningKey == "none" |
| If signing key is 'default', reads git global config to determine key | business_logic | setting.Repository.Signing.SigningKey == "default" || == "" |

## Error Handling

| Trigger | Status | Response | Retryable |
|---------|--------|----------|-----------|
| No GPG key configured or key is SSH format | 404 | notFound | False |
| gpg binary fails or key not found | 500 | APIError | True |

### Error Paths

- **No signing key configured (format empty)** → ctx.APIErrorNotFound → 404
- **Key format doesn't match expected (openpgp)** → ctx.APIErrorNotFound → 404
- **Error reading key or running gpg** → ctx.APIErrorInternal → 500

## ⚠️ Performance Issues

| Severity | Type | Description | Recommendation |
|----------|------|-------------|----------------|
| medium | no_caching | Every request executes git config commands and gpg --export process | Cache the exported GPG key since signing keys change very rarely |
| medium | no_timeout | gpg --export is called with timeout=-1 (no timeout) | Set a reasonable timeout (e.g., 10 seconds) for gpg execution |

### Optimization Recommendations

- **[P1] timeout**: Add timeout to gpg process execution — *Impact: Prevent request hangs when gpg is unresponsive*
- **[P2] caching**: Cache GPG public key export result — *Impact: Eliminate process spawn on every request*
